concept.zh: 环形互斥与并列最佳方案
concept.en: Circular exclusions and tied best plans

brief.zh: 沿环形轨道给若干信标供电，相邻两盏不能同时点亮，最后一盏也与第一盏相邻。收益列表 rewards 可含负数。返回 [最高总收益, 达成它的点亮方案数]，按选中的位置区分方案，允许一盏不点。环上仅一盏时可以点亮它，空环有一种空方案。
brief.en: Power any subset of beacons around a ring. Neighbors cannot both be lit, including the last and first. rewards can include negative values. Return [highest total reward, number of lighting plans that achieve it]. Different positions make different plans. You may light none. A lone beacon may be lit, and an empty ring has one empty plan.

snippets.code:
off = straight_row(rewards, 1, n)
    on = straight_row(rewards, 2, n - 1)
    on[0] += rewards[0]
    if on[0] == off[0]:
        return [on[0], on[1] + off[1]]
    if on[0] > off[0]:
        return on
    return off

label.zh: 首灯点亮后也纳入尾灯
label.en: Include the last beacon when the first is on

snippets.code:
off = straight_row(rewards, 1, n)
    on = straight_row(rewards, 2, n)
    on[0] += rewards[0]
    if on[0] == off[0]:
        return [on[0], on[1] + off[1]]
    if on[0] > off[0]:

    return off
